anti_theater_checks.description: Optional checklist of what would falsify the claim that a verifier ecosystem exists (kept short).

name.description: Who compiled/published this roster payload (not an endorsement).

disclaimer.description: Short statement: directory ≠ endorsement; entries may be self-attested; verify reports directly.

previous_roster_payload_sha256.description: Optional linkage to previous roster payload digest (anti silent rewrites).

roster_id.description: Opaque identifier for this roster instance (stable within a publication chain).

roster_version.description: Schema/payload version for this roster payload.

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number within the roster chain, if used.

coi_disclosure_digest.description: Optional pointer to COI/funding disclosure digest if published as evidence.

ttr_target_minutes.description: Self-stated target for publishing a digest-anchored verification verdict during a crisis window.

report_feed.description: Where this verifier publishes replayable PacketVerificationReports (URL or digest-index pointer).

last_drill_at.description: Last time this verifier ran a drill/publish cycle (self-reported).

verifier_id.description: Stable verifier identifier used in published reports where possible.

verifier_report_tbs_digest.description: Optional linkage to an implementation-scoped VerifierReport tbs_digest (see docs/193).

window_notes.description: Short note about the contested window and expected publication cadence.
